description: This PHP source file defines a class for a custom dashlet in SugarCRM / SuiteCRM, specifically displaying information about closed opportunities for the current user. It includes logic to fetch opportunity counts from the database and display them in a web UI, along with configuration options.

classes.name: MyClosedOpportunitiesDashlet
classes.description: A custom dashlet class for displaying the current user's closed opportunities and total opportunities count, with configurable options.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the dashlet, fetching total opportunities and closed-won opportunities for the current user.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the dashlet UI with opportunity data.

methods.name: displayOptions
methods.description: Provides the configuration UI for the dashlet.

methods.name: saveOptions
methods.description: Saves the user-defined options for the dashlet.
